newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK manufacturing employment fell 15.4 pct in June.
newsitem.headline: HK manufacturing employment fell 15.4 pct in June.

text.p: Employment in Hong Kong's manufacturing sector fell 15.4 percent in June 1996 from a year earlier, the Census and Statistics Department said.
Employment in wholesale, retail, import and export trades, restaurants and hotels rose 0.7 percent during the same period.
In the finance, insurance, real estate and business services sector, employment was up 3.5 percent while employment on construction sites was up 13.4 percent.
Employment in transport, storage and communications rose 6.0 percent and in community, social and personal services was up 4.9 percent.
The number of vacancies on construction sites down 56.2 percent.
